note: Both sets cover the same six facts with accurate values and supporting quotes, including the 2500/2900 g pull forces, 400 g total actuation force, 10 g per-louver limit, and the 200C-to-cryogenic transformation range. The only substantive difference is the condition attached to the 15-20C austenite range: A correctly ties it to the annual Irvine, CA temperature data used to establish it, while B attributes it to the Dynalloy wire specification, which the text only says the range fell within. That misbinding makes B's condition misleading, so A is slightly more faithful overall.
